notes: Runtime resources (schemas, SQL, synthetic fixtures) alone do not make a test mixed. Source checks and Git/evidence checks retain their true source host.
All entries remain selectable; T02 verification is targeted, not a claim of running every registry entry. No failed test is moved to historical to evade it.
